ios.desc:
Sheriff empowers you to protect your privacy online, by blocking JavaScript and Cookies on a per-domain basis.

Sheriff is free, for everyone, because privacy shouldn't be a privilege for only those who can afford it.

Per-Domain Control: Sheriff empowers you to decide which websites can use JavaScript and Cookies. Customize your settings on a per-domain basis to allow or block these elements where you want, when you want.

Enhanced Privacy: Safeguard your personal information from data-hungry websites. Sheriff gives you the power to protect your privacy by blocking cookies that can track your every move.

Faster Browsing: Disable JavaScript on resource-heavy websites to speed up your browsing experience. Load pages faster and save valuable mobile data!

Security First: Enhance your online security by disabling JavaScript on untrusted domains. Sheriff keeps your iOS device safe from potential threats and malicious scripts.

Block Annoying Pop-ups: Say goodbye to intrusive pop-up ads that disrupt your browsing experience. Sheriff lets you take control of the web, ensuring a smoother and less cluttered journey.

Cleaner, Faster, and Safer: Enjoy a cleaner web experience with fewer distractions and faster loading times. With Sheriff, you're not just blocking elements; you're crafting a better online world.

Data Saver: Control which websites can store cookies on your device, preserving your data and privacy. Sheriff puts you in the driver's seat when it comes to your online identity.

Universal Compatibility: Sheriff seamlessly integrates with Safari, making it easy for you to manage your web preferences without any hassle.

Synchronize your rules via iCloud to protect your privacy across all your devices.

Sheriff now enables you to unlock the full power of Safari Content Blocker with custom rules.

• Block more resources
  • Documents (HTML, XML, SVG)
  • Fonts, Style Sheets (CSS)
  • Images, Media (Audio, Video)
  • Popups, Pings, Fetches, Websockets
• Remove elements with CSS selectors
• Upgrade requests to HTTPS
• Target first- or third- party loads
• Target top- or child- frame contexts
• Include or exclude domains
• Include or exclude top URLs

Privacy Policy: https://primatology.xyz/privacy-policy
